title: Concept: TLS verification disabled for a download during the image build in dockerfile — review required
description: In dockerfile, the image build downloads content with certificate verification disabled. The build host trusts the network path completely, so an on-path attacker can substitute the artifact and every container built from the image inherits it. The flag is usually added to work around a broken internal mirror and then remains in the recipe.
applicability: dockerfile images that fetch tools or artifacts at build time.
risk: Supply-chain substitution during the build; MEDIUM severity.
